47 /*
48  * Component : L3 (NIC-301) GPV Registers - ALT_L3
49  * L3 (NIC-301) GPV Registers
50  *
51  * Registers to control L3 interconnect settings
52  *
53  */
54 /*
55  * Register : Remap - remap
56  *
57  * The L3 interconnect has separate address maps for the various L3 Masters.
58  * Generally, the addresses are the same for most masters. However, the sparse
59  * interconnect of the L3 switch causes some masters to have holes in their memory
60  * maps. The remap bits are not mutually exclusive. Each bit can be set
61  * independently and in combinations. Priority for the bits is determined by the
62  * bit offset: lower offset bits take precedence over higher offset bits.
63  *
64  * Register Layout
65  *
66  * Bits | Access | Reset | Description
67  * :-------|:-------|:------|:---------------------------------
68  * [0] | W | 0x0 | MPU at 0x0
69  * [1] | W | 0x0 | Non-MPU at 0x0
70  * [2] | ??? | 0x0 | *UNDEFINED*
71  * [3] | W | 0x0 | HPS2FPGA AXI Bridge Visibility
72  * [4] | W | 0x0 | LWHPS2FPGA AXI Bridge Visibility
73  * [31:5] | ??? | 0x0 | *UNDEFINED*
74  *
75  */
76 /*
77  * Field : MPU at 0x0 - mpuzero
78  *
79  * Controls whether address 0x0 for the MPU L3 master is mapped to the Boot ROM or
80  * On-chip RAM. This field only has an effect on the MPU L3 master.
81  *
82  * Field Enumeration Values:
83  *
84  * Enum | Value | Description
85  * :-------------------------------|:------|:-------------------------------------------------
86  * ALT_L3_REMAP_MPUZERO_E_BOOTROM | 0x0 | Maps the Boot ROM to address 0x0 for the MPU L3
87  * : | | master. Note that the Boot ROM is also always
88  * : | | mapped to address 0xfffd_0000 for the MPU L3
89  * : | | master independent of this field's value.
90  * ALT_L3_REMAP_MPUZERO_E_OCRAM | 0x1 | Maps the On-chip RAM to address 0x0 for the MPU
91  * : | | L3 master. Note that the On-chip RAM is also
92  * : | | always mapped to address 0xffff_0000 for the MPU
93  * : | | L3 master independent of this field's value.
94  *
95  * Field Access Macros:
96  *
97  */

99  * Enumerated value for register field ALT_L3_REMAP_MPUZERO
100  *
101  * Maps the Boot ROM to address 0x0 for the MPU L3 master. Note that the Boot ROM
102  * is also always mapped to address 0xfffd_0000 for the MPU L3 master independent
103  * of this field's value.
104  */
105 #define ALT_L3_REMAP_MPUZERO_E_BOOTROM 0x0

109  * Maps the On-chip RAM to address 0x0 for the MPU L3 master. Note that the On-chip

112  */
113 #define ALT_L3_REMAP_MPUZERO_E_OCRAM 0x1
